part:chassis.title: Chassis
part:chassis.desc: Drive tub: floor, motor saddles, battery cradle, sensor windows. Hides the wheels.

part:glow_ring.title: Light band
part:glow_ring.desc: Translucent ring: mood light and night-light. The tail grows out of it.

part:mantle.title: Mantle
part:mantle.desc: Upper body shell with the neck collar and head-servo saddle built in.

part:dome.title: Head dome
part:dome.desc: One shell: hooded brow, round face window and the camera "third eye". Clear-smoke in production.

part:face_frame.title: Face frame
part:face_frame.desc: Inner frame that tilts with the head. Holds the eye screen, brain board and speaker.

part:tail.title: Tail
part:tail.desc: Soft TPU tail on a micro servo: wags, perks up, droops.

part:dock.title: Dock
part:dock.desc: Crescent charger with two copper pads and an IR homing beacon.

elec:motor_l.title: N20 gearmotor 75:1 + magnetic encoder
elec:motor_l.desc: Pololu 75:1 Micro Metal Gearmotor MP 6V, extended shaft, run at 5 V: ~0.8 m/s top speed on 60 mm wheels; 12 CPR magnetic encoder (x75 = 900 counts per wheel turn).

elec:bracket_l.title: Micro metal gearmotor bracket
elec:bracket_l.desc: Pololu bracket pair: two M2 screws each into the chassis saddles.

elec:motor_r.title: N20 gearmotor 75:1 + magnetic encoder
elec:motor_r.desc: Pololu 75:1 Micro Metal Gearmotor MP 6V, extended shaft, run at 5 V: ~0.8 m/s top speed on 60 mm wheels; 12 CPR magnetic encoder (x75 = 900 counts per wheel turn).

elec:bracket_r.title: Micro metal gearmotor bracket
elec:bracket_r.desc: Pololu bracket pair: two M2 screws each into the chassis saddles.

elec:wheel_l.title: Wheel 60 x 8 mm
elec:wheel_l.desc: Pololu 60 x 8 mm wheel pair, silicone tyre, press-fit on the 3 mm D-shaft. Wheels sit inside the body: Wisp glides, no visible wheels.

elec:battery.title: Li-ion pack 3.7 V 4400 mAh (2 x 18650)
elec:battery.desc: 16 Wh, with protection PCB. Stands on edge behind the axle to keep the centre of mass low and between the wheels and the caster. ~3 h roaming, ~10 h idle-watching (estimate).

elec:pico.title: Raspberry Pi Pico (body controller)
elec:pico.desc: The "spinal cord": 1 kHz wheel speed loops, odometry, cliff + bump reflexes, IR dock homing, servos, light band. Talks to the head over UART at 921600 baud.

elec:drv8833.title: DRV8833 dual motor driver
elec:drv8833.desc: 2 x 1.2 A H-bridges, PWM from the Pico; rides on top of the Pico.

elec:boost.title: 5 V 4 A boost regulator
elec:boost.desc: Battery (3.0-4.2 V) to 5 V for motors, servos, LEDs and both boards.

elec:charger.title: bq24074 charger / power path
elec:charger.desc: 1.5 A Li-ion charging from the dock pins or rear USB-C; runs the robot while charging. Sits on a bridge over the battery.

elec:tof.title: VL53L7CX 8 x 8 time-of-flight sensor
elec:tof.desc: 64-zone depth at 15-60 Hz, 90 deg field of view, 4 m: obstacle and drop-off map in front of the robot, tilted 5 deg down.

elec:irrx_l.title: TSOP38238 IR receiver (x2)
elec:irrx_l.desc: 38 kHz receivers, +-25 deg: read the dock's left / right beam codes to home in.

elec:irrx_r.title: TSOP38238 IR receiver (x2)
elec:irrx_r.desc: 38 kHz receivers, +-25 deg: read the dock's left / right beam codes to home in.

elec:cliff_0.title: QTR-1RC cliff sensor (x3)
elec:cliff_0.desc: IR reflectance under the floor: a drop under any sensor stops the wheels in < 5 ms (Pico reflex, not the brain).

elec:cliff_1.title: QTR-1RC cliff sensor (x3)
elec:cliff_1.desc: IR reflectance under the floor: a drop under any sensor stops the wheels in < 5 ms (Pico reflex, not the brain).

elec:cliff_2.title: QTR-1RC cliff sensor (x3)
elec:cliff_2.desc: IR reflectance under the floor: a drop under any sensor stops the wheels in < 5 ms (Pico reflex, not the brain).

elec:imu.title: LSM6DS3TR-C 6-axis IMU
elec:imu.desc: Heading for odometry, bump / pick-up / tip detection ("put me down!").

elec:pogo_l.title: Pogo charging contacts (x2)
elec:pogo_l.desc: Spring pins at the front skirt meet two copper pads in the dock: 5 V in.

elec:pogo_r.title: Pogo charging contacts (x2)
elec:pogo_r.desc: Spring pins at the front skirt meet two copper pads in the dock: 5 V in.

elec:servo_tail.title: Tail servo SG92R
elec:servo_tail.desc: +-35 deg wag at up to 4 Hz: happy, curious, sleepy, alert.

elec:ledstrip.title: Light band: 13 RGB LEDs
elec:ledstrip.desc: Addressable LEDs behind the translucent band: mood, battery, listening, and a soft night-light.

elec:servo_head.title: Head tilt servo MG92B (metal gear)
elec:servo_head.desc: Nods the head -20/+15 deg: looks up at you, down at the floor or the cat.

elec:lcd.title: 1.28" round IPS LCD (240 x 240)
elec:lcd.desc: GC9A01 round display: the eye. Iris, lids and glyphs are drawn by the head at 30 fps.

elec:xiao.title: XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense (head brain)
elec:xiao.desc: Dual-core 240 MHz + 8 MB PSRAM: personality engine, on-device wake word (ESP-SR), person / face detection (ESP-DL), the eye animation, Wi-Fi check-in video.

elec:camera.title: OV3660 camera (on the XIAO Sense)
elec:camera.desc: 3 MP, sits behind the brow lens hole; tilts with the head.

elec:amp.title: MAX98357A I2S amplifier
elec:amp.desc: 3 W class-D from the head's I2S port.

elec:speaker.title: Speaker 30 x 20 mm, 1 W
elec:speaker.desc: Chirps, purrs and a speaking voice; fires through the chin slots.

elec:mic.title: PDM microphone (on the XIAO Sense)
elec:mic.desc: Wake word and sound events (glass break, dog bark: designed, not trained).

elec:dock_mcu.title: Dock beacon: XIAO ESP32-C3
elec:dock_mcu.desc: Pulses two 940 nm IR LEDs with left / right codes on a 38 kHz carrier, and powers the pads.

elec:dock_led_1.title: IR LED 940 nm (x2)
elec:dock_led_1.desc: Split by the baffle so the beams only overlap on the centre line.

elec:dock_pad_1.title: Copper contact pads (x2)
elec:dock_pad_1.desc: 5 V from a USB-C supply through the dock to the robot's pogo pins.

elec:dock_led_-1.title: IR LED 940 nm (x2)
elec:dock_led_-1.desc: Split by the baffle so the beams only overlap on the centre line.

elec:dock_pad_-1.title: Copper contact pads (x2)
elec:dock_pad_-1.desc: 5 V from a USB-C supply through the dock to the robot's pogo pins.
